creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found by hand in round 1 (2026-09-25). Outside any pane with two windows open, muster daemons fans out to every window and prints 'a list of daemons' under each window heading instead of the daemons: the fan-out renders only window answers (crates/muster-cli/src/render.rs named_or_empty, from 2026-09-01). daemons is about the machine, not a window, so it should ask one window rather than fan out.
title: muster daemons outside a pane with two windows prints a placeholder per window
